Originally a citizen of Crandor, Melzar was chased away by Elvarg. In his incredibly intricate and over-engineered maze he went quite crazy. Once upon a time, he was determined to restore his former friends and allies to life after the massacre on Crandor, but he now appears to be more obsessed with cabbages.

Quest: Dragon Slayer

Combat: Surely you remember this mad geezer! In-between shouting random abuse, he'll cast a fire magic attack; 'zap' you; punch you; reduce your strength and summon cabbages.
